047289: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_array_bound_evaluate(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CArrayBound bound, u64* count_out)
047290: {
047291:     CIrQueryFrame result = {0};
047292:     if (!c_ir_query_execute(builder, (CIrQueryFrame){.bound = bound, .kind = C_IR_QUERY_FRAME_ARRAY_BOUND}, &result) || !result.success)
047293:     {
047294:         return false;
047295:     }
047296:     *count_out = result.integer;
047297:     return true;
047298: }

047300: // Answers the alignment the specifiers in [alignment_start, alignment_count)
047301: // ask for: the maximum of `natural_alignment` and every request. The sizeof
047302: // folding in c_parse_layout_alignment_specifiers walks the same records and
047303: // must reach the same number.
047304: //
047305: // A GNU `aligned(N)` only ever raises, so an N the type already satisfies is
047306: // exactly the no-op the maximum computes on its own -- a header defending
047307: // itself with `aligned(2)` on an already 4-aligned member keeps its layout.
047308: // `_Alignas` carries the opposite rule, since C requires a declaration's
047309: // alignment to be at least the natural one, and Clang measures the largest
047310: // request in the declaration rather than each one: `_Alignas(2)
047311: // __attribute__((aligned(8))) int` is accepted, `_Alignas(2) int` is not.
047312: //
047313: // A rejected run still fills *alignment_out with the usable maximum, so the
047314: // caller can finish the layout and report `*rejection_out` against the
047315: // attribute instead of leaving a type nothing downstream can name.
047316: //
047317: // `requested_out`, when asked for, receives the largest alignment any of the
047318: // records *asks* for, before it is merged with the declared type's natural
047319: // alignment. Only the bit-field placement rule needs that raw number: GNU
047320: // `aligned(N)` starts a bit-field at the next multiple of N bytes even when N
047321: // is below the declared type's own alignment, while every other reader of a
047322: // request only ever raises with it. Zero means no record resolved.
047323: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CIrAlignmentStatus c_ir_alignment_evaluate(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 alignment_start, u32 alignment_count, u32 natural_alignment,
047324:                                                              u32* alignment_out, u32* requested_out, String8* rejection_out)
047325: {
047326:     IrProgram* program = builder->program;
047327:     CParseResult parse = builder->parse;
047328:     IrTypeId* c_type_ir_map = builder->c_type_ir_map;
047329:     u32 alignment = natural_alignment;
047330:     u64 requested_maximum = 0;
047331:     bool standard_below_natural = false;
047332:     CIrAlignmentStatus status = C_IR_ALIGNMENT_RESOLVED;
047333:     if (alignment_start > parse.alignment_count || alignment_count > parse.alignment_count - alignment_start)
047334:     {
047335:         return C_IR_ALIGNMENT_PENDING;
047336:     }
047337:     for (u32 index = 0; index < alignment_count; index += 1)
047338:     {
047339:         CAlignmentSpecifier specifier = parse.alignments[alignment_start + index];
047340:         u64 requested = 0;
047341:         if (specifier.type.value < parse.type_count)
047342:         {
047343:             IrTypeId type = c_type_ir_map[specifier.type.value];
047344:             IrType* value = ir_type_from_id(&program->types, type);
047345:             if (!value || !value->layout.resolved)
047346:             {
047347:                 return C_IR_ALIGNMENT_PENDING;
047348:             }
047349:             requested = value->layout.alignment;
047350:         }
047351:         else if (!c_ir_array_bound_evaluate(builder, (CArrayBound){
047352:                                                 .token_start = specifier.token_start,
047353:                                                 .token_count = specifier.token_count,
047354:                                             },
047355:                                             &requested))
047356:         {
047357:             return C_IR_ALIGNMENT_PENDING;
047358:         }
047359:         if (!requested)
047360:         {
047361:             continue;
047362:         }
047363:         if (requested > UINT32_MAX || (requested & (requested - 1)))
047364:         {
047365:             if (status == C_IR_ALIGNMENT_RESOLVED)
047366:             {
047367:                 *rejection_out = string_format(builder->arena, S8("alignment specifier requests {u64}, which is not a power of two the target can align to"), requested);
047368:                 status = C_IR_ALIGNMENT_REJECTED;
047369:             }
047370:             continue;
047371:         }
